messages:
alex: Quick report: after switching dev sampleapp to fast-reload, we lose request IDs on the first 1-2 requests. Seems like telemetry init and req-id middleware race. Repro attached.

rita: confirmed locally. The Node example uses async init which delays binding the OTEL context. Logger shim emits before request id attached.

devops: customer also saw this in a short-lived container (cold start). They can't block init.

nick: redaction complicates things: our scrubber strips hex-like tokens before the req-id normalizer runs, so even when id is present it's wiped. Order of operations needs fixing.

qa-bot: Created ticket INT-4720 (reqid-loss + redaction-order). Priority P3.

alex: Proposed short-term patch: add an early fallback middleware that generates a lightweight req-id and tags logs; once OTEL binds we replace with canonical id and emit metric telemetry.counter('reqid.fallback'). Long-term: docs change to show sync init or explicit guidance.

rita: I'll update quickstart to show both patterns and call out hot-reload caveat. devops: can we whitelist X-Request-Id in redactor so it's preserved?

devops: yes we'll add preserve_headers and run normalizer before scrubbing. Also add unit tests across Node/Python/Go to ensure parity.

alex: I'll open PR with fallback middleware + tests today. tagging @rita @devops. Can we canary this in the dev sampleapp next week?

telemetry-bot: PR tracker created: #pr/telemetry-fallback-2234. Adding to INT-4720.
